title: CMS Guide Pages — database-backed content management, batch JSON import, and conversion-optimised page template
description: Move guide page content from hardcoded TypeScript to a Convex-backed CMS. Includes: guidePages/guideRevisions/redirects Convex tables, admin panel CRUD with draft-review-publish workflow, batch import of 62 JSON files from docs/cms-import (EN+NL), a standard Markdown-rendered page template with hero image and four conversion zones, and a visitor-to-account conversion strategy with funnel-aware CTAs. Validation source of truth: plans/feature-cms-guide-pages/testplan.md.
acceptance: AC-01–AC-37 in plans/feature-cms-guide-pages/README.md all pass. npx tsc --noEmit passes. All pre-existing tests pass. pnpm run build succeeds. All 31 imported guide pairs are live on the public site. Three CTA zones fire analytics events with correct section labels.
